nodes.title: LEVEL 1 BRIEFING
nodes.message:
THE COLONY REACTOR IS OFFLINE.
REACH THE CORE BEFORE THE
SHIELD COLLAPSES.
GOOD LUCK PILOT.

nodes.title: STORY
nodes.text:
YEAR 2087. THE OUTER COLONIES
LOST CONTACT WITH EARTH.

A SINGLE SCOUT SHIP WAS SENT
THROUGH THE GATE.

IT NEVER CAME BACK.

YOU ARE THE SECOND ATTEMPT.
